graph.name: IHS Markit: Virtual Instructor-Led Trainings with IHS Markit (now part of S&P Global)
graph.notes:
[VERY INTERESTING!]
    Virtual software training platform.
    The product is PETRA technical application, which requires high-end configurations with GPUs; use AWS AppStream to deliver the software.
    Students simply click streaming URL to access the software.
    Use Filesystem! Potentially because it is a high-end software.
    It is mentioned the software also runs on Desktop (but requires high-end GPUs and CPUs), which may imply why it uses FS.

nodes.name: EC2
nodes.notes: WORKLOAD_PEEK: license server; execute customized image building commands from lambda (through Systems Manager) by remoting into AppStream image builder

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes:
NOTES: image building takes 20-45 mins, but lambda only allows 15 min max, so has to use EC2 for command executions via Systems Manager
WORKLOAD_PEEK: customize app stream image builder for cloudformation template

nodes.name: FSX
nodes.notes: DATA_PEEK: mount for the virtual software training app in the AppStream

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes:
NOTES: previously use a full SQL server, but each project is very small for training; switch to a SQL express engine reduces the cost by 80%
DATA_PEEK: store data for the virtual software training app
